# Skill plan, Maps 0-20 (2026-11-08, DES2)

**Design only: nothing here is applied.** Generated by `tools/des2/skill_plan_2026_11_08.py` (data: `skill-plan-maps-0-20-2026-11-08.json`), from the owner's notes 11-08 10:52, the Codex draft and DES1. Every name below was checked against `canonical/skill-delivery.json` and the engine's statuses. The engine and `canonical/cards.json` win over this page.

Owner: *"Seems like there is quite a lot of skills to work around with. I agree - let's limit and focus in."*

**Marks:** ✓ exists · ≡ exists under another name (the game's name shown, the Codex name in brackets) · ★ new · ◦ a parameter of an existing skill (purple label, not NEW!). The number after a candidate = carriers on that map's list today (target 2+).

**In short:** only **2 genuinely new skills** (Pressure, Vaccinate) and 4 parameters of existing skills (Bandage = Cure, Undertow = Wave, and the owner's 11:03 Armoured Shield = Shield and Retreat into the shell = Shell, both for ENG37). Everything else the Codex asked for already exists, often under another name. 15 duplicate groups, 76 renames.

Each rise: every unit on the field takes 1 water damage that ignores Armor (as Crushing Depths); units with Tide or Pressure take none and gain +1 Armor for the fight (at most +2 from Pressure). Deep water (a Crushing Depths field): each rise deals 2, and the gauge goes to 4. | Crushing Depths is a field that hurts every round; Pressure is a unit that raises the stakes a few times and rewards deep-sea units. No existing skill grants Armor to a group or hits the whole field more than once. |
| **Vaccinate** | new (Map 7 signature) | Vaccinate N (default 2): when it arrives, it and its adjacent allies are Immune to Sleep, Paralyze, Venom and Decay for N rounds (a timed ENG36 Immune entry: the status never lands and the unit shows the "held off" float). It removes nothing already on them. | ENG36 Immune is printed on one card for good. Immunity (ENG24) is self-only and covers sickness, not Sleep. Wakeful is self-only, Sleep only. Cure removes, Vaccinate prevents: the first skill that protects others. |
| **Vulnerable** | exists as Exploit (use it) | Exploit N already does exactly this: its hits put N tokens on the target; each later hit (melee, shot, bolt; not a Venom or Bleed tick) deals +1 and uses one token, before Armor. On no card today. | Shock (+50%) is called "Vulnerable" by the SK3 status action, and Unfortify gives the bramble "Vulnerable N". One Cure family with a target: Venom (Cure), wounds (Bandage), spores (the witchdoctor's remedy: Sleep and Paralyze). |

Together the Shield lasts longer against many small hits, then the unit is plain again. Home: Conch Crawler (Shell + Shield) on Pebble Beach. |

Plain Shell stays "+N Armor when first hit each round". | Same family, a different moment: Shell braces when hit, the retreat ducks back after striking (good against Counterattack and the Speed 0 arrows that come after the swings). Home: the hermit crabs and Box Turtle. |

### Pressure: who the owner's version favours

- **Favours:** high-Health units, Armor-ignoring hits (Pierce, magic, Psychic) and Venom / Bleed (ticks ignore Armor). The side that plays it last, after its own board is up.
- **Hurts:** swarms, tokens and 1-4 Health units (2 a rise kills them: Brood, Bloom copies, Swarm), and every 1-2 Attack unit, which deals 0 after two rises of Armor. Most of Maps 0-10 is such cards.
- **Risk:** Armor for everyone, uncapped, stalls fights (nobody can hurt anybody) and the CPU mirrors it. Symmetric, so it has no home deck.
- **Tuned version** (the table above): 1 a rise, at most 3 rises, Armor only for Tide / Pressure units (a deep-sea reward that makes the minor Tide skill matter), deep water doubles it. Decision DES2-1.

### Map 7: mushrooms, spores and the witchdoctor

- Puffball (new): when hit, the attacker falls Asleep for a round: Poison Barbs {status: sleep}, not a new skill.
- A cordyceps-struck ant (new): on-hit Paralyze; dies into a 1/1 spore token (On Death: spawn).
- Nightshade Moth (exists, out of play): on-hit Sleep 50% for 2. Moves to Map 7.
- **Cures:** Any damage already wakes a sleeper (engine). Add: Wakeful (Sleepless Shrew, out of play), Vaccinate (prevention), and the witchdoctor's Cure {vs: spores} (removes Sleep and Paralyze).

| Witchdoctor idea | Card today | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Truffle Piglet | exists, Map 7 | a piglet in a mushroom-cap mask with a gourd of spores: Vaccinate |
| Marsh-mallow Hare | exists, out of play (Cure 1) | a hare herbalist chewing marshmallow root: Cure {vs: spores} |
| Peat-smoke Shaman | exists, out of play (Cure 1, Heal 1) | a toad in peat smoke; better as Map 5's curer |
| Moss Sloth | new | moss and mushrooms grow in its fur; slow, heals and vaccinates (the unexpected animal) |
| Bone-belt Capuchin | new | the owner's monkey with a belt of bones: a hex doctor (Daunt + Cure {vs: spores}) |

**Dropped:** Cold, Tangleweed (retired), Snare, Suffocate, Burrow (= Invisible), Adrenaline (= Riled), Recoil as displacement (it is a drawback), Swift (on no card).

Keep Stagger (halve) and Corrode (Acid's status). |
| **Holds a unit in place** (10) | web 2, bola 3, strangle 2, constrict 0, lasso 1, tangle 2 | Web: no dodge, no moving. Bola: Pinned. Strangle: Bound + 2. Constrict: no action + 2. Lasso: both tied. Tangleweed: half its actions fail, which is Confused. | Retire **Tangleweed** (Weaver Bird to Confuse, Quicksand Queen to Web). Merge Constrict into **Strangle** {full}. Keep Web, Bola, Lasso. |
| **Takes more damage** (7) | exploit 0, scar 1, shock 3, expose 3 | Exploit: +1 a hit, one token used per hit (the owner's Vulnerable). Scar: +N for good. Shock: +50% (the SK3 action calls it Vulnerable). Expose strips hiding. | Exploit's tokens read **Vulnerable**; the SK3 "Vulnerable" action reads Shock. Merge Scar into Vulnerable {lasting}. Keep Expose. |
| **Heals allies** (7) | healing 6, nursing 1, bloom 0 | Heal: most wounded ally 1. Nursing: weakest wounded ally N. The heal-a-random-ally "Bloom" shares its name with the copy-making Bloom. | Merge Nursing into **Heal** {N}. Rename the healing Bloom (key bloom) to avoid two Blooms. |
| **Grows when units die** (6) | harbinger 0, berserk 2, carrion 3, scavenge 1, retribution 0, hiveMind 0 | Each fires "when a unit dies". Harbinger +1/+1 (any), Berserk +N/+0 (allies), Carrion heals 2, Scavenge Lumber, Retribution strikes, Hive Mind buffs a Swarm ally. | Merge Berserk into **Harbinger** {who: ally, gives}. Keep Carrion (heal) and Scavenge (resource). Retribution and Hive Mind: one-offs. |
| **Attacks twice** (6) | twinStrike 2, doubleTime 0, frenzy 2, coffee 2, encore 0 | Twin Strike swings twice (two damage instances). Double Time = Twin Strike + its shots twice. Frenzy = Twin Strike while it has a status. Encore = again on a kill. | Keep **Twin Strike**; Double Time becomes Twin Strike {shots}. Keep Frenzy and Encore (conditions differ). Coffee: one-off. |
| **Bramble damage on hit** (6) | breach 5, puncture 0, perforate 1 | Breach: 1 to the bramble a melee hit. Puncture: N. Perforate: Puncture + Pierce + Bleed bundled. | Merge Breach into **Puncture** (Breach = Puncture 1). Keep Perforate as a later-map bundle. |
| **Grows on a kill** (5) | momentum 1, spoils 0, midas 0, felling 3, prospector 1 | Momentum +N/+0, Spoils +0/+2; Midas / Felling / Prospector: gain Lumber / Lumber / Metal. | Merge Spoils into **Momentum** {hp}; Midas and Prospector into **Felling** {res} (like Delivery's res). |
| **Lumber and Stone by stats** (5) | timber 1, hoard 2, rockSolid 1, ironWill 1 | Timber and Hoard have the same text (+1/+1 a Lumber). Rock-solid / Iron-will: per Stone / Metal. | Merge Timber into **Hoard** {res, N} (ENG36 already phrases Hoard N). |
| **Many deaths** (4) | requiem 1, dirge 1, carnage 1, tally 1 | All four: "+2/+2 while N units have died". Only who counts differs (any / yours / enemies seen / enemies). | Merge into **Carnage** {who: any | yours | foes | seen, N}. One threshold skill. |
| **Many units on the field** (4) | muster 1, beset 1, throng 1, sociable 1, formation 0 | Muster / Beset / Throng: "+2/+2 while N units" on your side / theirs / both. Sociable and Formation: +1 per ally nearby (range 2 vs adjacent). | Merge Muster / Beset / Throng into **Throng** {who, N}; Sociable into **Formation** {range}. |

Retiring the merged keys removes about 15 skill names from the catalogue. Decision DES2-3.

## 4. Card names, Maps 0-20

Owner: *"I want Map 0-20's card names to be simple ... pyrenean xxx too complicated ... the common animals first ... blue-ringed octopus later."* Direction: non-faction animals are plain now; armed / geared animals come on later maps; some non-faction cards may subtly hold a primitive item (a monkey with a belt of bones). Card ids stay; each rename re-keys the 12 card language packs (`lang/cards/*.json`) and the art prompt.

## 5. Ideas parking lot

- **Glide:** Flying's little brother for gliders (flying squirrel, sugar glider, flying fish): dodges 1 in 4, lands in any free slot. Canopy maps.
- **Height:** A field altitude. Low atmosphere (peaks): Flying weaker, Fire weaker. Below sea level: Pressure rises on its own.
- **Extremophile maps:** Vents: every round, units not beside a vent take 1 acid, venom or heat. Dry, Immunity and Mountain Climber shrug it off. Tardigrade, yeti crab, Pompeii worm.
- **Space (secret map):** Zero gravity: every unit counts as Flying, no Fire, no Tide. Tardigrade as the reward.
- **Halve / double:** Feeble, Mighty, Sturdy, Fragile, Rage: later maps (owner #21). Mighty on Map 14 and 19 is the only early use.
